name: Hibiki Wataru
source:
Wataru is a multi-talented genius gifted in drama and good at magic tricks. As cheering and energetic, Wataru values love and surprises a lot. His performances and bold and gorgeous, with cheerful and joyful singing and dance.

An idol with a flair for acting and magic tricks. Wataru is restless and full of energy. He also treasures love and surprises. With cheerful dancing and singing, he delivers bold, showy performances.

A member of Starmaker Production's fine.
